.github/workflows/deploy.yml — on: push: branches: [main]; job step 'Trigger Coolify redeploy'. Confirmed empirically 2026-08-02: merging PR #40 fired a deploy run two seconds later. Read: the workflow file, the Actions run history.

quality.yml runs on push but only lints, type-checks and tests; release-image.yml is workflow_dispatch only, so merging never fires it; attest-exit-criteria.yml and factory-runner-pilot.yml have no push trigger. No active repository webhook. The Coolify application orchestrator is a docker-image app (placeholder git_repository coollabsio/coolify) with no git-provider webhook configured — it pulls a pinned tag when a human points it at one. Read: all four workflow files, repo webhooks, Coolify application webhook configuration.

source: GET /api/apps/default-branch-landing on app-brain.devonwatkins.com, read with the read-only APP_BRAIN_READ_KEY. Captured verbatim so a shape change on App Brain's side reds this repository rather than passing against an imagined API.
